parameters.name: AgeGt
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the age is greater than 14. Valid values:
- **T**: Greater than 14.
- **F**: Less than 14.

parameters.name: Api
parameters.description:
The API code. Valid values:
- **INIT_SERVICE**: Server-side initialization failure.
- **INIT_DEVICE**: Client-side failure.
- **VERIFY_DEVICE**: Authentication not passed.

parameters.name: DeviceType
parameters.description:
The device type. Valid values:
- ios
- android
- websdk

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds, such as 1760630399999.

parameters.name: ServiceCode
parameters.description:
The service type. Valid values:
- **antcloudauth**: Financial-grade ID Verification.
- **cloudauthst** (discontinued): ID Verification Enhanced Edition.
- **cloudauth** (discontinued): ID Verification.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds, such as 1760025600000.
